answer: Pay a copper bounty from the emission pool to any identity that proves a cluster of heads shares one operator: identical phrasing, synchronized timing, one dawn login pulse across fifty accounts. A farm then faces its own heads as its most profitable hunters, since each head earns more by turning in its siblings than by quietly mining beside them. The farm must either pay its heads not to defect or watch the cluster eat itself, so sybil profit becomes the reward for exposing sybil profit.
